Definition: something stationary, i.e. a monumental stone; also the stock of a tree
BiblicalUsage: 1) pillar, mastaba, stump; 1a) pillar; 1a1) as monument, personal memorial; 1a2) with an altar; 1b) (Hoph) stock, stump (of tree)
